recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/data_vectors/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
o=$(mktemp -d)
versions=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --comparison)
for ver in $versions; do
  python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/cosebis_data_vector.py \
    --version "$ver" \
    --reporting-binning bins_20 --integration-grid bins_1000 --mode-count n_max_20 \
    --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
    --out-file "$o/$ver"_cosebis_modes.npz
done
tar czf results/submitted/data_vectors/cosebis_modes_sweep.tar.gz -C $o .
